takeaways.text: Lines up **Inline (tight)** on **54%** of 216 plays (n=117); also Slot 24% (n=52).
Route on **92%** / blocks on **8%** of dropbacks (95% CI 87–95%, n=216) — 5 pts above the TE average of 86%.
From **SINGLEBACK** (formation), route rate is **58%** (CI 36–77%, n=19) — less likely to run a route than his overall 92%.

Because he releases into a route on ~92% of dropbacks and most often from Inline (tight), a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.
